spec.name: Simply supported aluminium beam — left symmetric half
spec.description: Left half of a 240 mm beam, with symmetry at x = 120 mm and half of the full mid-span load.

supports.note: Full-width bottom support restraining vertical and sideways displacement.
Zero displacement normal to the mid-span symmetry plane.

loads.note: Half of the full beam's 2000 N downward line load.
